records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Basic foods and staples, including grain, fish and cheese.
records.localization_note: Basic foods and staples, including grain, fish and cheese.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Sugar, honey, salt and cooking oils. The compact abbreviation keeps this separate from Spices; Seasonings Shop exceeds the current caption width.
records.localization_note: Seasonings names the broad family of ingredients, including salt, sugar, honey and cooking oils. The original Square menu supplies the retail context. The separate Spices Shop keeps pepper and similar goods distinct.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Special foods such as caviar, shark fins and nuts. Delicacy fits at full width and distinguishes them from staples.
records.localization_note: Special foods such as caviar, shark fins and nuts. Delicacy fits at full width and distinguishes them from staples.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Pepper, cloves, saffron and other spices. The familiar category name distinguishes them from the separate cooking seasonings.
records.localization_note: Spice is the idiomatic modifier for the shop that sells pepper, cloves and other spices.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Specialty indulgences such as coffee, tea, cocoa and tobacco. The category covers goods bought for enjoyment.
records.localization_note: Specialty indulgences such as coffee, tea, cocoa and tobacco. The category covers goods bought for enjoyment.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Alcoholic goods including wine, spirits and sake. Liquor Shop is a familiar umbrella name for an alcohol retailer.
records.localization_note: Alcoholic goods including wine, spirits and sake. Liquor Shop is a familiar umbrella name for an alcohol retailer.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Gold, silver and platinum. The compact term is distinct from Ore Shop, and Precious Metals Shop exceeds the caption width.
records.localization_note: Gold, silver and platinum. The compact term is distinct from Ore Shop, and Precious Metals Shop exceeds the caption width.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Manufactured wares including glass, china, lacquerware and inlaid ware. Crafts signals the worked products.
records.localization_note: Craft Shop names the finished wares category. Its glass, china, lacquerware and inlaid ware are products of skilled craft.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Fiber and woven goods such as wool, silk and their cloth. The existing compact label identifies the broad trade family; Textile Shop remains a clearer wording lead.
records.localization_note: Textile Shop is an idiomatic label for the trade in raw textile fiber and finished cloth. The original category includes both, so the caption keeps the broader textile trade in view.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Luxury wares such as carpets, art and fine furs. The qualifier is already idiomatic before Shop.
records.localization_note: Luxury wares such as carpets, art and fine furs. The qualifier is already idiomatic before Shop.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Aromatic products such as musk, frankincense and ambergris. Scents covers the trade ingredients without implying they are finished perfumes.
records.localization_note: Scent Shop covers aromatic materials such as frankincense, musk and ambergris without implying finished perfume.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Decorative materials such as jade, ivory and coral. Jewelry distinguishes ornamental wares from the separate stock gemstones.
records.localization_note: Decorative materials such as jade, ivory and coral. Jewelry distinguishes ornamental wares from the separate stock gemstones.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Pearls, diamonds and other precious stones. Gems clearly identifies the gem trade.
records.localization_note: Gem Shop names the retailer of loose gemstones and pearls. Jewelry remains the separate label for ornamental materials.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Medicinal trade goods such as ginseng, quinine and cordyceps. Medicine spells out the category and fits in the original cell.
records.localization_note: Medicinal trade goods such as ginseng, quinine and cordyceps. Medicine spells out the category and fits in the original cell.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Dye goods including indigo and cochineal. The category stays recognizable as a shop label.
records.localization_note: Dye Shop names the retailer of colorants such as indigo, cochineal and turmeric.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Arms and equipment including guns, cannon, blades and armor. Arms is concise and suits the period setting.
records.localization_note: Arms and equipment including guns, cannon, blades and armor. Arms is concise and suits the period setting.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Unprocessed mineral goods such as iron, copper and tin ore. Ore distinguishes the shop from Metals.
records.localization_note: Unprocessed mineral goods such as iron, copper and tin ore. Ore distinguishes the shop from Metals.

records.speaker: Square shop menu
records.source_meaning: Miscellaneous supplies such as timber, leather and wax. Sundries identifies the miscellaneous category and avoids the generic Goods Shop.
records.localization_note: Miscellaneous supplies such as timber, leather and wax. Sundries identifies the miscellaneous category and avoids the generic Goods Shop.
